_note: PubMed Central open-access papers. Full texts are NOT in the repository (license); scripts/fetch_papers.py downloads them. role: core = exercise for older adults with type 2 diabetes (the questions are answered from these); distractor = same-looking but other topic (exercise motivation / chatbots / other diseases) or the diabetes DIET shelf (50 papers), so retrieval has to find the right papers among similar ones - the same design as the diabetes PoC corpus.
